brief.scope: Author independent tests for the task-owned C2 outputs declaration, rendering and semantic envelope validation in accepted ops/devlane/task/CONTRACT.md and dispatch CONTRACT.md. Read owner and worker-launch acceptance inputs. This bounded prerequisite fixes declared output meaning before launcher grant adoption; do not cover executor consolidation, host grants or new conduct mechanics yet. Derive tests from accepted public interfaces and fixtures; exact file/scratch authority, decoded absolute handles, transport separation, historical records and narrow inline exception must hold. Hermetic unittest tests under ops/devlane/task/tests; test/fixture edits only, no implementation/contracts/settings/catalogue edits. Prove intended red on this ref, distinguish setup/import failures, preserve existing tests. Report missing public seams explicitly, exact command, coverage rows and frozen paths/hashes.

Missing public seam envelope.validate_outputs; omission must be [], explicit null refuses, grammar/overlaps/duplicate JSON members/transport collisions refuse, and the function must not take a job name.
Missing public seam envelope.outputs_from_job; a missing outputs key is [], explicit null refuses, and prompt prose must not authorize writes.
Missing public seam envelope.render_declared_outputs; check-tests at /jobs/example/out must render the contract example byte-for-byte with JSON string substitutions.
Missing public seam envelope.append_declared_outputs; strip trailing CR/LF from the native prompt, then append two LFs and the Declared job outputs section.

envelope.validate does not accept outputs=, out_root= or inline_planning_exception=; newly declared file handles must equal the decoded rendered absolute path exactly. Historical validate() without those parameters still holds.
